mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE UPCHAIN AS ( SELECT SH.SESSION_CD AS SESSION_CD , SH.HOST_CMPNY_CD AS HOST_CMPNY_CD , SH.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD AS DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD , 1 AS DEPTH FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE SH WHERE SH.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND SH.DEL_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT P.SESSION_CD , P.HOST_CMPNY_CD , P.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD , U.DEPTH + 1 FROM UPCHAIN U INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE P ON ( P.SESSION_CD = U.SESSION_CD AND P.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = U.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' ) WHERE U.DEPTH < 20 AND U.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD <> U.HOST_CMPNY_CD ), REACH AS ( SELECT DISTINCT SESSION_CD FROM UPCHAIN WHERE DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD = HOST_CMPNY_CD )

( SELECT IFNULL(HC.CMPNY_NM, '') FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_SHARE HS LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY HC ON ( HC.CMPNY_CD = HS.DESIGNATED_BY_CMPNY_CD ) WHERE HS.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND HS.SHARE_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND HS.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select:
/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSession */ SELECT SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , SITE_CD AS siteCd , TITLE AS title , STATUS_CD AS statusCd , ENTRY_PWD AS entryPwd , EXIT_PWD AS exitPwd
, MANAGER_GPS_LAT AS managerGpsLat , MANAGER_GPS_LON AS managerGpsLon , MANAGER_GPS_LAT_ENC AS managerGpsLatEnc , MANAGER_GPS_LON_ENC AS managerGpsLonEnc , GPS_VERIFY_TYPE_CD AS gpsVerifyTypeCd , GPS_VERIFY_RADIUS_M AS gpsVerifyRadiusM FROM TB_TBM_SESSION WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{sessionCmpnyCd} AND SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectAvailableSessions */
SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS title , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', S.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt
, AS hostCmpnyNm FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.STATUS_CD = 'OPENED' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND ( (S.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd}) OR ( S.CMPNY_CD <> #{cmpnyCd} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM REACH R WHERE R.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD) ) ) ORDER BY S.OPENED_AT DESC, S.SESSION_CD DESC

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectCompletedSessions */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS title , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', S.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(S.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, AT.EXIT_AT), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd , AS hostCmpnyNm FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT
INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND AT.USER_TYPE_CD = #{userTypeCd} AND AT.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (S.STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' OR AT.EXIT_AT IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, AT.EXIT_AT) DESC, AT.ATTENDANCE_CD DESC

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSessionAttendees */ SELECT CASE WHEN AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN RU.USER_NM ELSE DU.USER_NM END AS userNm , DATE_FORMAT(AT.ENTRY_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS entryAt FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER RU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = RU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = RU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER DU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'DAILY' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = DU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = DU.USER_CD )
WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND AT.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{sessionCmpnyCd} AND S.SESSION_CD = AT.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY AT.ENTRY_AT, AT.ATTENDANCE_CD

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSessionState */ SELECT S.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , DATE_FORMAT(S.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(S.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , ST.SYNC_STATE_CD AS syncStateCd FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_STATE ST ON ( S.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = ST.SESSION_CD )
WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{sessionCmpnyCd} AND S.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSessionContents */ SELECT SC.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , M.TITLE AS title , SC.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder , SC.OVERRIDE_DESC AS overrideDesc FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( SC.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND SC.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD )
WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{sessionCmpnyCd} AND SC.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = SC.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSessionRisks */ SELECT C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , RT.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , CASE WHEN RA.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN RA.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus , B.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , SR.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK SR INNER JOIN TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT RA ON ( SR.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND SR.SITE_CD = RA.SITE_CD AND SR.PROCESS_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND SR.ASSESSMENT_CD = RA.ASSESSMENT_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON ( RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE RT ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = RT.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = RT.RISK_TYPE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND RA.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD )
WHERE SR.CMPNY_CD = #{sessionCmpnyCd} AND SR.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = SR.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = SR.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY SR.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSessionMaterialTitles */ SELECT M.TITLE FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( SC.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND SC.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD )
WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{sessionCmpnyCd} AND SC.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = SC.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectInProgressAttendanceSessionCds */ SELECT AT.SESSION_CD FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND AT.USER_TYPE_CD = #{userTypeCd} AND AT.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND AT.EXIT_AT IS NULL
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.SESSION_CD = AT.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY AT.SESSION_CD
